svg.title: Robot mascot
svg.desc: A cream robot with a dark visor face watches a sign-in form. Its glowing eyes look around and blink, then look down as an email is typed; for the password it pulls privacy blinds over its eyes and whistles; while checking, its ear dials spin; a failed sign-in gets a sad shake and a drooping antenna, and success gets happy eyes, raised arms and confetti.
